about.title: About Wagner Feedmill
about.text: Wagner Feedmill is a specialist in the development, production and installation of feed manufacturing plants. State-of-the-art CAD design, qualified staff and powerful production facilities guarantee the highest quality. Our solutions serve industry (20–100 t/h), agriculture (0.5–20 t/h), as well as premix and grain handling sectors.

annahme-reinigung.title: Intake & Cleaning Systems
annahme-reinigung.description: Cleaning systems for removing foreign bodies from bulk materials. Reliable preparation before further processing.
annahme-reinigung.long: Our intake and cleaning systems reliably remove foreign bodies from bulk materials and ensure consistent raw material quality for your feed production.

siloanlagen.title: Silo Plants & Grain Dryers
siloanlagen.description: Dryers for grain, corn and rice with long service life and uniform drying process.
siloanlagen.long: Silo plants and grain dryers from Wagner Feedmill offer long service life, uniform drying and secure storage for grain, corn and rice.

foerdertechnik.title: Conveying Technology
foerdertechnik.description: Drag chain conveyors and bucket elevators for horizontal and vertical bulk transport.
foerdertechnik.long: With drag chain conveyors and bucket elevators we implement efficient horizontal and vertical transport of bulk materials in your plant.

mahl-misch.title: Grinding & Mixing Plants
mahl-misch.description: Hammer mills and horizontal mixers with mixing accuracy up to 1:100,000.
mahl-misch.long: Hammer mills for grain and granulates plus horizontal mixers with 1:100,000 mixing accuracy for highest product quality.

premix.title: Premix Plants
premix.description: Dosing of micro components with precise scale accuracy.
premix.long: Premix plants dose micro components with highest scale accuracy for concentrates and pre-mixes.

pelletierung.title: Pelleting Systems
pelletierung.description: Pellet presses from 200 kg/h to over 45 t/h from meal mixtures.
pelletierung.long: Pellet presses from 200 kg/h to ≥ 45 t/h convert meal mixtures into high-quality pellets for industry and agriculture.

extrusion.title: Extrusion
extrusion.description: Extruders for converting grain feed into pet and fish feed.
extrusion.long: Extruders convert grain feed into specialized pet and fish feed with defined structure and quality.

steuerung.title: Control Systems
steuerung.description: Full automation, remote control and redundant backup server.
steuerung.long: Control systems with full automation, remote control and second backup server for maximum operational reliability.

futterwagen.title: Feed Wagons & Mobile Plants
futterwagen.description: Tractor-driven grinding and mixing plants directly in the store.
futterwagen.long: Mobile grinding and mixing plants and feed wagons enable flexible tractor-driven processing directly in storage.

silos.title: Silos
silos.description: Storage of products before further processing in robust silo systems.
silos.long: Silos for secure storage of raw materials and intermediate products before further processing in your plant.

absackanlagen.title: Bagging Plants
absackanlagen.description: Bagging of 1–50 kg sacks, up to 600 bags per hour.
absackanlagen.long: Bagging plants for 1–50 kg bags with capacities up to 600 bags per hour for efficient end packaging.
